title: Sindhu Flags Gruelling Asian Games Schedule After Quarterfinal Exit
indian_angle: PV Sindhu, a prominent Indian shuttler, voiced concerns about the demanding schedule at the Asian Games following her quarterfinal loss.
summary: Indian badminton star PV Sindhu criticized the intense schedule at the Asian Games, where she played three singles matches within 18 hours, which she believes contributed to her early quarterfinal exit.

title: National Coaching Camp Begins for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This national camp is vital for nurturing India's young badminton talent and preparing them for a major international junior competition.
summary: A national coaching camp has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare India's junior badminton players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: The course aims to elevate the coaching standards within India, which is crucial for the long-term development of Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's promising U17 and U15 junior players for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact how young Indian players compete and develop in national and ranking tournaments.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has introduced a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
